title: Grove's Artifact documents the same controller functions twice, and the two copies have already drifted apart
content:
`setDelegatedSigner`, `removeDelegatedSigner`, `prepareUSDeMint`, `prepareUSDeBurn`, `cooldownAssetsSUSDe`, `cooldownSharesSUSDe` and `unstakeSUSDe` are each specified twice: once under the Monolithic Mainnet Controller (A...2.1.2.10.1 through A...2.1.2.10.7) and again under the Ethena instance's "Instance-specific Operational Processes" (A...3.1.4.1.3 and A...3.1.4.2.3).

The copies differ in at least three ways:

- **Guards.** The general copy shows a body-level `_checkRole(RELAYER)` with no `isActive`; the instance copy shows modifiers `onlyRole(RELAYER) isActive` (A...2.1.2.10.1.1 versus A...3.1.4.1.3.2.1).
- **Rate-limit invocation.** The general copy calls `_rateLimited(LIMIT_USDE_MINT, usdcAmount)` inside the body; the instance copy shows `rateLimited(LIMIT_USDE_MINT, usdcAmount)` as a modifier (A...2.1.2.10.3.2 versus A...3.1.4.1.3.4.2).
- **Approval mechanism.** The general copy uses the library helper `ERC20Lib.approve(proxy, usdc, ethenaMinter, usdcAmount)`; the instance copy issues `proxy.doCall(usdc, usdc.approve(ethenaMinter, usdcAmount))` directly (A...2.1.2.10.3.3 versus A...3.1.4.1.3.4.3).

One of each pair is stale. That matters more than usual here because the Artifact's own convention elsewhere is to specify **by reference** — the entire Foreign Controller section (A...2.3) says "the same as through the Monolithic Mainnet Controller" rather than restating anything, precisely to prevent this. The Ethena instance departs from that convention and immediately exhibits the failure it protects against.

The practical consequence for anyone using the Artifact as an operational reference: where two sections describe the same function, neither can be trusted as authoritative without checking the deployed code.
description: The general controller sections show _checkRole(RELAYER) and ERC20Lib.approve; the instance sections show onlyRole(RELAYER) isActive and a raw proxy.doCall approve, for identical functions.
